Tests: establishment means

Source: R/test-docs.R
test_establishment.Rd

establishment_introduced flags records with establishmentMeans introduced, naturalised (either spelling) or invasive; establishment_managed flags managed or cultivated individuals. Matching ignores case and surrounding spaces.

Fields

establishment.

CoordinateCleaner

No equivalent; additions of this package.

See also

flag_occurrences(), flag_tests()

Other tests: test_age_equal, test_age_outlier, test_age_range_outlier, test_aohi, test_basis, test_capital, test_centroid, test_country_mismatch, test_dataset_ddmm, test_dataset_rounded, test_duplicate, test_equal, test_gbif_headquarters, test_gbif_issue, test_institution, test_invalid, test_outlier, test_range, test_sea, test_spatiotemporal_outlier, test_urban, test_zero

Examples

x <- data.frame(establishmentMeans = c(NA, "MANAGED", "native", "Naturalised"))
f <- flag_occurrences(x, tests = c("establishment_introduced", "establishment_managed"))
f[, c("flag_establishment_introduced", "flag_establishment_managed")]
